data.gender_notes: Harshad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives pleasure despite being harsh or difficult. Derived from Sanskrit words: Harsh (difficult) and Da (giver). The name Harshad carries the meaning “Harsh (difficult) + Da (giver)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshad usually hope their child will grow to embody harsh (difficult) + da (giver) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harshad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Harsh (difficult) + Da (giver).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harshad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Harshad holds a significant place in Hindu mythology and culture. In the sacred texts of Hinduism, such as the Puranas and Vedas, Harshad is mentioned as a term that represents the divine presence that brings joy and pleasure despite appearing harsh or difficult. It is a reminder that even in the most challenging circumstances, the divine will always find a way to bring happiness and fulfillment.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Harshad lies in the concept of the divine being the giver of pleasure and joy, even in the face of adversity. It reminds us of the fundamental truth of life that even in the most challenging circumstances, we can find joy and fulfillment through the grace and blessings of the divine. The name Harshad serves as a reminder to stay grounded in our spiritual practice and to remember that joy and happiness are not dependent on external circumstances, but rather on our inner connection to the divine. By embracing the name Harshad, we are actively choosing to focus on the divine as the giver of all pleasure and joy, even in the most difficult situations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Harshad is composed of two syllables- Har and Shad. Har means 'happy, joyful' and Shad means 'number six'. Thus, Harshad symbolically represents a person who is as joyful and happy as the number six. Harshad is a name that embodies the essence of joy and happiness, with the first syllable 'Har' meaning joyful or happy, and the second syllable 'Shad' representing the number six. Together, Harshad signifies an individual who carries the inner radiance and contentment of someone who experiences joy and happiness akin to the number six.
